Solasta 2 UPDATE 1 is HERE! Warlock Class, Multiplayer and MORE!!
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be talking a little bit about Solasta 2. They just had their update 1 in Early Access came out yesterday. So, In this video, I want to talk a little bit about what has been added to the game and why you might want to jump back into it if you haven't played in a while.
